title: When the Semester Burns
author: Astrid Thackeray
blurb: Mirabel Fairweather, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before the final audition.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
